bio.text: Nellie Unangiq Jimmie, a Democrat, has represented District 38 in the Alaska House of Representatives since 2025.

According to the legislative biography, Jimmie lists Toksook Bay as a place of residence from 1987 to the present, graduated from Nelson Island High School in 1996, and is a Yupik, Ojibwa and Lakota descendant.
The biography lists a family-owned business, Bayview General Merchandise Inc., and service as Toksook Bay's representative on the Alaska Village Electric Cooperative board.
